items.title: RTX's Pratt & Whitney invests $25 million to expand precision parts manufacturing in Niepołomice, Poland
items.excerpt: Pratt & Whitney will invest $25 million to expand its Niepołomice, Poland plant for complex tubular assemblies and precision engine components. The expansion is due online in 2028, adds 120+ jobs, and supports GTF, PW800 and F135 production; RTX says 2026 investment in its Polish P&W facilities totals $125 million.
items.query: site:rtx.com Pratt Whitney September 2026 Poland engine components manufacturing

items.title: RTX's Collins Aerospace to support modernization of U.S. Army's Chinook helicopters
items.excerpt: Collins Aerospace received a U.S. Army contract worth up to $472 million for engineering services supporting CH-47 Chinook avionics modernization and sustainment. The work advances open, reusable avionics architectures intended to reduce integration complexity and ease technology insertion across aircraft.
items.query: site:rtx.com/news/news-center/2026/08 Collins Aerospace digital engineering avionics modernization RTX

items.title: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Initiates an Orderly Transition of MHICA Assets in Mississauga, Ontario to Bombardier
items.category: 航空機・主要サプライヤー
items.excerpt: MHI and Bombardier agreed for Bombardier to acquire MHI Canada Aerospace assets in Mississauga, subject to approvals. The site brings aerostructure manufacturing capability and about 750 employees; MHI will provide transition support while retaining other commercial aerospace and defense activities.

items.title: SimScale opens Engineering AI agent to its global community
items.excerpt: SimScale opened its Engineering AI agent to 900,000+ users; it states the agent can execute CAD cleanup, simulation setup and reporting across a complete simulation workflow. Discovery candidate: direct agentic CAE execution and broad aerospace/manufacturing use make SimScale worth persistent monitoring.
items.query: engineering AI simulation aerospace August 2026 company CAE SimScale

items.title: Building Beyond CAD: On Generative Optimization for Engineering
items.excerpt: PhysicsX describes adapting 3D foundation models for engineering geometry, steering generated shapes toward physics objectives, and validating production-suitable meshes with numerical solvers. Discovery candidate: it directly targets generative engineering beyond parametric CAD and serves aerospace/defense.
items.query: site:physicsx.ai/newsroom Building Beyond CAD August 25 2026 PhysicsX

items.title: How an AI Agent Cracked an Industry Benchmark
items.excerpt: PhysicsX reports an AI-agent workflow that reverse-engineered the hidden constitutive behavior behind Safran's PLAID Tensile2D benchmark, building and iterating a simulator from labeled data. Discovery candidate: it links agentic reasoning, constitutive modeling and CAE benchmark integrity.
items.query: site:physicsx.ai/newsroom How an AI Agent Cracked an Industry Benchmark August 11 2026
